text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the street—

text_block_list.name: Man in Black A
text_block_list.text:
...This way.
Hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Woman in Tuxedo
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to our company's casino game tournament!
All you wager against each other is your own pride.
Please enjoy this one-day-only competition♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sheesh. I thought I spotted a face that didn't belong, and of course it's you again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this is a clean and proper tournament, got it?
Even if an unregistered guy sticks his nose in—

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey. It's her...!
The legendary dealer, "Angel-sama"...!
Ah, to think I'd actually lay eyes on her in person...!!
choice_data_list: Angel-sama, as in the one from the riverbank before...?

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you guys are... hehe.
Long time no see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, well. From the looks of it,
Angel-sama's quite the popular celebrity around here.

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
And the one chosen by that popular celebrity is you.
Well then—shall we wager our mutual pride?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
An opponent personally picked by Angel-sama herself...?! 
Who is that... Horse Girl...?
Giggle, there's no way she can beat Angel-sama...

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
The game is poker. Receive your chips from the attendant.
The rules are pretty much standard.

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
There's just one special rule.
Any hand Flush or higher requires a "bounty."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Full House, Four of a Kind...
If hands like that show up, you have to pay chips on top of bets and raises, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Trainer, be my wall.
I want to hide my hand from the gallery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so the poker game began.
The first round went to us with a pair of Kings.
The second was a draw, but the third round brought another victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Momentum was undoubtedly on Nakayama Festa's side.
Having whittled down the opponent's remaining chips, the fourth round arrived.
A chance for a decisive blow presented itself—

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text: ...Call. How about you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Trash hand. Fold, I'm out.
Let me step outside for some fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That should've cleared out the rest of the deck.
Give 'em a good shuffle while you're at it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: Even though you had Three of a Kind...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Show one, Show all.
Even if the hand is over, don't go spilling what I had.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, she was holding a Flush or better.
If I'd stayed in, that "bounty" would've triggered.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just a hunch, though. More importantly,
getting the deck shuffled was crucial this time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...In this poker game, cards were discarded and new ones dealt after every hand.
In other words, it made counting possible.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A technique to track the remaining cards.
Proof is, she made sure to force my hand open every single time. But—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Once the deck runs dry and the entire deck gets shuffled,
her bank of information drops right down to zero.
This is when you gotta bet on "monstrous luck"—the showdown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna go all-in together?
Don't worry about the difference in chips.

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
! You're throwing away your hard-earned lead?
If you offer terms like that... I'm taking the bet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Be my guest. The tension was making my shoulders stiff anyway...
Rather than settling for a safety net, I wanna stay "hungry."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Dealer.
Change that card and make the call.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her eyes closed, Nakayama Festa
points to a single card.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Her demeanor bore a striking resemblance
to Special Week back during the Memory tournament.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later, the venue was in an uproar.
A mysterious Horse Girl had taken down the legendary dealer with a Straight Flush.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after that single game, without taking on any other gamblers,
she promptly slipped away and vanished—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. At the academy,
I spotted Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, it's you. Sorry for the trouble back then.
Though with things getting that noisy, anyone would've bolted.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't go there to become popular,
I went there to gamble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of her as she spoke, a bus was waiting.
...Come to think of it, I believe I saw news of her upcoming race this morning.
choice_data_list: You're heading off to your next showdown, aren't you?
You're heading off to your next showdown, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Looks like it's gonna be a bit of a tough nut to crack, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Well, keep your eyes peeled.
I'll make it an interesting gamble for sure.
